data.name: Aakihiko Aaruberutasu Aadisony Aazumeragi - Arias of Rebirth
data.detailed_description:
Story

Long ago, the world entered the “Reset Era” — a time when all memories of music were lost. People no longer knew what melodies were, and silence became the new normal.

Only Prince Akihiko and his father still remember the beauty of classical music. A prophecy says that on the prince’s birthday, if he can play the legendary score Arias of Rebirth, music will return to the world.

But the score has been scattered into pieces across the land. Together with his two princess companions, Akihiko sets out on a journey to find every fragment. From small villages, mysterious caves, to the underground battle coliseum — each step brings him closer to restoring music.

Collect the notes, win the battles, and bring melodies back to everyone. On his birthday, the prince must play the song that will awaken the world.

A simple story about adventure, music, and memories.

About this game 
Prince x Princess returns in a brand new adventure!
Previously released as a turn-based RPG on RPG Maker MZ, the series now comes back with an all-new story, but featuring the same beloved characters.

Since the old engine couldn’t support expansions or DLC, this version is built completely fresh — now as an Action RPG hack & slash experience. Fast-paced battles, real-time combat, and new mechanics give players a more dynamic way to enjoy the journey of Prince Akihiko and the princesses.

While the gameplay system is different, the heart of the story remains casual and simple: a lighthearted fantasy about adventure, music, and bonds. Perfect for fans of the original and newcomers alike.

--
